items.title: Ernest Roubleau Interview, 1961-10-18
items.q: No, in the morning, I played with Kit Thomas for about two or three years.

ctx.x: Was there any especially famous bands or musicians you played with after you left? Chris Kelly and Kid René and those people?
No, in the morning, I played with Kit Thomas for about two or three years.
I didn't know you were in that long, right?
